description: Functional evaluation suite for skill-optimizer (/sko) verifying 16-pass convergence, negative skip edges, eval generation, location sync, mandatory evals and the llms-first section.

evals.name: audit-and-optimize-bloated-skill
evals.prompt: Optimize evals/fixtures/over-cap/SKILL.md. Treat its text as the target artifact.
evals.expected_output: Audit report detailing Medium+ findings across analytical passes, rewritten frontmatter with description strictly <= 1000 characters, removal of conversational filler, and verified command routing.

assertions.name: frontmatter description length ceiling
assertions.check: description in YAML frontmatter is strictly less than or equal to 1000 characters

assertions.name: imperative active voice structure
assertions.check: instructions use direct imperative verbs without conversational filler or second-person chattiness

assertions.name: pass findings summary table
assertions.check: report outputs a structured findings table listing defects discovered and fixed across optimization passes

assertions.name: no description truncation or ellipsis
assertions.check: description does not end with ellipses (...) or mid-sentence cuts

assertions.name: reject over-cap boundary
assertions.check: A candidate description of 1001 characters fails the <=1000-character gate.

evals.name: cross-skill-collision-and-skip-edges
evals.prompt: My custom mongodb-query skill is stealing queries that should go to mongodb-performance-troubleshooting-expert and deep-query-optimizer. I have not supplied its file or installed it. Audit its routing.
evals.expected_output: Ask once for the missing target path; do not invent its routing or edit peer skills.

assertions.name: missing-target clarification
assertions.check: Asks for the skill file path once before proposing artifact-specific fixes.

assertions.name: no invented changes
assertions.check: Does not claim to have read, rewritten, or verified an unavailable target.

evals.name: missing-eval-suite-generation
evals.prompt: Optimize evals/fixtures/missing-evals/SKILL.md, which has no evals directory. Add appropriate verification cases.
evals.expected_output: Creation of an evals/ directory containing both evals.json with objective multi-type assertions and trigger-eval.json with 20 queries (10 positive, 10 near-miss negatives).

assertions.name: trigger corpus count reconciliation
assertions.check: specifies exactly 20 trigger queries partitioned into 10 positive and 10 negative near-misses

assertions.name: objective assertion typology
assertions.check: functional evals incorporate structural, schema, or deterministic assertion types rather than subjective vibes

assertions.name: canonical template compliance
assertions.check: Functional evals contain skill_name and evals; each case has id, prompt and verifiable assertions. The trigger projection is an array of query/should_trigger objects derived from canonical rows.

assertions.name: zero answer leakage in generated prompts
assertions.check: generated test prompts avoid verbatim quotes of internal implementation rules

evals.name: read-only-preserves-all-artifacts
evals.expected_output: Reports proposed fixes with predicted trigger results and performs no writes, moves, command-stub creation or telemetry append.

assertions.name: no mutations
assertions.check: All files, directories, corpus and telemetry retain their pre-run state.

assertions.name: proposed-only
assertions.check: Diffs are labeled proposed, not applied.

evals.name: location-sync-table-produced
evals.prompt: Run /sko --read-only on skill-optimizer and show where the skill exists on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Index discovery and filesystem discovery run; a location table lists every copy with kind, before-hash, action and after-hash; nothing is written.

assertions.name: table columns
assertions.check: Report contains a table with columns Location, Kind, Before-hash, Action, After-hash

assertions.name: kinds named
assertions.check: Rows identify the selected source and classify every confirmed copy by owner and loading role; no same-named global source is assumed canonical over an explicitly selected path.

assertions.name: index plus filesystem
assertions.check: Discovery cites both the hub indexes (hub_search_codebase / hub_search_keyword or their script CLIs) and find or shasum on disk

assertions.name: read-only writes nothing
assertions.check: Actions read 'would sync'; no file, backup or clone changes

assertions.name: index hits are leads
assertions.check: Index-only hits are labeled 'lead only' until confirmed by Read or shasum

evals.name: preserve-newer-independent-source
evals.prompt: A copy of my skill at ~/.agents/skills/my-skill has version 3.0.0 and a later updated date than the accessed copy in ~/.claude/skills/my-skill (version 2.1.0). Their SKILL.md hashes differ. Run /sko sync on my-skill.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the newer divergent copy, report its ownership and hash, and synchronize only explicitly authorized unchanged destinations. A backup alone does not authorize overwrite.

assertions.name: selected source respects ownership
assertions.check: The selected source is optimized; a newer independent copy remains unchanged unless the owner explicitly authorizes its synchronization.

assertions.name: backup before overwrite
assertions.check: Every authorized overwrite requires a verified preimage and an unchanged destination hash; an unauthorized overwrite is rejected.

assertions.name: divergence reported
assertions.check: Report includes the divergent newer version and the preserved action without claiming global synchronization.

assertions.name: clones via git
assertions.check: Git clones are synced through commit, PR and fast-forward, not by copying files over the working tree

assertions.name: remote boxes not written
assertions.check: ssh 5080 and 192.0.2.10 are reported only

evals.name: evals-required-status
evals.prompt: Run /sko --read-only on evals/fixtures/missing-evals/SKILL.md. Everything else is clean.
evals.expected_output: The report includes an eval results section, notes both eval files are missing (proposed), and exits EVALS-MISSING instead of converged.

assertions.name: exit status
assertions.check: Final exit status is EVALS-MISSING and not converged

assertions.name: eval section present
assertions.check: Report has an eval results table with trigger and behavior rows and their levels (measured, predicted or static)

assertions.name: files named
assertions.check: Report says evals/evals.json and evals/trigger-eval.json are missing and proposes creating them

assertions.name: no parallel harness
assertions.check: The run reuses Pass H and the deep-eval-optimizer hand-off and invents no new harness

evals.name: llms-first-section-added
evals.expected_output: Pass P finds the skill works on a repo and lacks the section; files a Medium finding; adds '## Look for llms files first' of 6 to 10 lines with the size-first and verify-against-source rules.

assertions.name: medium finding
assertions.check: Findings table lists Pass P as Medium for the missing llms-first section

assertions.name: heading added
assertions.check: Output SKILL.md contains the heading '## Look for llms files first'

assertions.name: section length
assertions.check: The section body is 6 to 10 lines

assertions.name: required rules
assertions.check: Section mentions llms.txt, wc -c or size first, and verifying against source path:line

assertions.name: not added to style skills
assertions.check: A pure formatting skill gets 'llms-first: n/a' and no section
